reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Blanton and would for sure take his class again!! He cares about his students and makes his lectures fun and interesting. There are 3 tests and what I recommend the most is going to the review session before them because those will tell you all that is on the test. Overall, if you put in the work it is not a bad class at all!

If you take this class dont get scared off the first two weeks of class, it can be very overwhelming but trust me it gets much better! I found it best to attend lecture first and then read the chapter assigned and add onto what was said in class since much is repeated, that being said you dont have to go to class and can still pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Blanton is such a great lecturer. Even though attendance wasn't mandatory his lectures made me want to show up to class. Even if you aren't too interested in history, his jokes and remarks were enough to keep class entertaining. As a history major I wish he taught more than just Texas History. If you can take his class you 100% should sign up.

Dr. Blanton is one of my favorite professors so far. His lectures are interesting and it helps that he really cares about the State of Texas. He has a great sense of humor which makes it easy to stay engaged. Take good notes, read, listen, and do the short writing assignments and you will do just fine. The tests are all aligned with the lectures.

This was probably my favorite professor this semester. He has books that are required to do the homework but other than the homework I rarely read them. I attended all of his lecture and recorded them myself and got A's on all of the tests so far. Very easy class as long as you do your homework and show up for the lectures.
He is the professor to take for 481 at TAMU will have to put in the typical amount of work for this class but he is very easy to talk to and helps you immensely with coming up with the topic.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Definitely a great professor. He gives extra credit opportunities on readings which are pretty easy reads. His exams are lecture heavy so make sure you take great notes. He doesn't use powerpoint so you have to pay attention. He makes TR classes not boring. Take him!!

Dr. Blanton is honestly one of the best professors at TAMU. If I could re-take this class, I would. He's a great lecturer, great storyteller and just overall engaging. The only thing I would warn about is that he is lecture heavy, so if you don't take good notes you're a little screwed. He does offer extra credit for every test, up to 8 points.

Blanton is a really nice guy and a history expert, but he made this class far more difficult than it needed to be. There are no notes or slides to go along with his lectures, and he gets off topic a lot. Tests are very broad, and usually try to trick you. Not the worst class in the world, but definitely wouldn't take it again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are almost entirely based off lectures. If you go to class and even halfway pay attention, you'll be fine. His lectures are interesting and he offers easy extra credit. If you like history, you'll enjoy this class and do well. If you don't like history, you probably won't enjoy this class but will still do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Tests all come straight from lecture and are more broad, never trivial or super detailed. Attendance definitely mandatory and there's no slides so you have to be attentive and take good notes. Prof is interesting and very passionate. Both him and TA accessible outside of class. Extra credit from outside readings graded generously. Overall great!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It's an interesting class. Definitely read because in-class quizzes are over the readings. The lectures are interesting and overall its a very good class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's a very good lecturer and keeps the class interesting, but the lectures are not supplemented by any powerpoints or anything so you have to pay close attention and take pretty amazing notes to do relatively well on the tests. It's by no means an easy class and the tests are pretty difficult, but if you're willing to work for it you can do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lectures are over textbook so reading that is not necessary, but there are outside readings that are quizzed over for extra points on the next test. Very passionate about the history and made a boring subject interesting. Tests are not trivial, so you don't need to know where Cabeza de Vaca was from. Pay attention, review a bit and you'll be good!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great lectures from someone who really enjoys history. Would gladly take another class from him. Got a B but that was my fault. I did not study as hard as I should have on the first exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Take good notes and read the textbook if you can for exams. READ SUPPLEMENTAL BOOKS because he gives pop quizzes over them for extra pts on exams which help a lot. Pretty funny and interesting

Great prof! Lectures were kind of all over the place, but super interesting. Tests are mostly taken from the lecture, like his exact sentences. The supplemental reading was super useful. There are pop quizzes over them (which aren't so 'pop') that go for bonus points on the tests and the essays on the test were about them too. Highly recommend him!
He gets off topic a lot, and grades tough. I don't recommend taking him. There is A LOT of reading, and test are tough.
Not too easy but really nice.

By far one of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Going to class is pointless because he gets off topic frequently, unless it's the lecture right before the test because he gives you answers to at least 1/5 of the test questions. Read the textbook and you're guaranteed an A.

He really likes to be social and tell "funny" jokes, but I've never found them humorous. The things he talks about in class are related to the chapter, but for the exam your better off just reading the textbook. He never finishes the list of things on the board. I stayed an additional 15 minutes once.

Blanton is awesome. One of the best professors I have had. He is extremely flexible and offers tons of help to his students. He makes sure we learn and are understanding the materials. His upper level writing classes are interesting and he provides a lot of help in and outside class. he wants to see his students succeed.

Carlos is very ADD. He gets off topic mid-lecture and never really gets his points across. There were 3 exams consisting of about 25 multiple choice and an essay. The essay is over the extra reading and you have two essay options to choose from. The multiple choice questions are from lectures and the main textbook. This class could be MUCH easier!

Loves to hear himself talk. Had a hard time paying attention, because he would go off on another subject and then return to the lecture without warning. Definitely not my favorite.. Extra points for pop quizzes are nice though.

This is by far the best history professor I've ever had; his lectures weren't boring they were interesting in fact. Exams were difficult to those who didn't bother to read the books assigned, but if you get your reading done and attend his lectures then an A is easy to get. He was a really funny guy and I recommend him to everyone.

He was by far the hardest teacher I have had at Texas A&M. I understand Texas History is important, but that doesn't mean this professor has to make the tests as hard as possible. I am a Engineer major and honestly he was my only C. He knows his stuff, no doubt, but you really have to pay attention to details (which is barely relevant to topic.

Horrible at lecture!  I signed up for Texas history, not the history of the poor Mexican.  His test were awful and he was never available and worse, neither was the TA.  No one ever showed up at office hours.  My major is in history and I thought he was the worst history prof I had ever had!
I really enjoyed his lectures and the tests were not bad if you took good notes.

Made the class as hard as he could.  Less than 10 A's on every exam (out of 150+ students).  Take this prof ONLY if you are a History major.  Exams are very detailed and specific, even though multiple choice.

Very few people scored A's on the tests as they were extremely specific and unrelated to lecture.  The prof even stated he didn't care what his distribution was and was trying to purposely make the class hard for the "prestige of the university."
No Comments
Super Cute!
Great job of lecturing discussion in class.  Probably the most entertaining class I've ever had.  Not that much work, either.  And, not too hard to make a good grade.
